verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence documents no way to act on many existing items at once, such as bulk edit, bulk tag, bulk delete, or a batch API endpoint. CSV/spreadsheet import, data export and list filtering are adjacent features that move or view data, not bulk operations across selected items, so they earn no credit. The API evidence covers authentication only and says nothing about batch operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
